title: random
text:
random

zoe: Huge thank you to @kaito and @meera for saving my office plant while I was OOO. It was one droopy leaf away from tragedy. :seedling:
kaito: happy to play plant sitter. watered, talked to it, and played classical music. plants deserve playlists. :notes:
meera: watered and renamed it 'Resilience' after the return email. :grin: also left a tiny note with care tips.
jay: shoutout to facilities too for letting us borrow the humidifier. teamwork wins. :raised_hands:
facilities-bot: Facilities note: Humidifier loan recorded. Please return by Friday.
zoe: coming back to a thriving plant felt like a warm welcome home. thank you all. i'm baking cookies tomorrow as a thank-you offering. :cookie:
kaito: cookies accepted. also adding a sticker to the plant for morale. :sticker:
meera: love this. small acts, big impact. pinned for retro. :sparkles:
